data.name: Sharjeet
data.gender_notes: Sharjeet is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sharjeet is derived from the Sanskrit words shri, which means king, and jay, which means victory. It is a name that signifies triumph and success. The name Sharjeet carries the meaning “King of Victory” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Punjabi. Parents who choose Sharjeet usually hope their child will grow to embody king of victory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sharjeet is a name that embodies the spiritual qualities of courage, determination, and triumph over adversity. It is a name that inspires confidence and respect.
data.etymology: Sharjeet belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “King of Victory.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharjeet total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
